_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 Oct) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (community sources).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

recommendations.what: Move Seth's Epic gloves and boots to Howard, and Howard's Rare ones to Forrest
recommendations.why: Howard is the main tank in all four combat lineups but wears Rare gloves and boots. Seth is a gathering hero in no lineup, and his Epic gloves and boots beat Howard's on every stat. Howard's own Epic helmet (+20) and chest (+19) are better than Seth's, so keep those. Howard's freed Rare pieces (+20, +19) go to Forrest, the infantry hero in the Be march, instead of Seth; Seth takes Forrest's +12 pieces so no slot is left empty.

recommendations.what: Promote Quinn to 4★ first: 3 shards to go
recommendations.why: Quinn is at 97 / 100 shards and now sits in Arena attack, Arena defense, Barricade 1 and Att. His preview shows +37,360 power at 4★ (+105 Attack, +108 Defense, +648 Health). Next closest: Helga 5 to T1, Saul 14 to 2★. On 22 Oct Howard and Forrest reached T4 and Edwin T3.
steps: Later: Helga 5 to T1, Saul 14 to 2★ (unlocks 2 skills).
evidence: hero.md shard counts, Quinn's promotion screen of 22 Oct (97 / 100)
recommendations.cost: 4–14 shards each; shard sources not recorded
recommendations.note: Shard counts are verified; where to get shards is not recorded.

recommendations.what: Save 5 more Epic Expedition Manuals, then upgrade Gordon's Emergency Snack to Lv 3
recommendations.why: Gordon's skill screen of 22 Oct shows 25 Epic Expedition Manuals. His Emergency Snack (Lv 2) needs 30 for Lv 3 (heals 55% → 60% of his Attack every 5 s), the cheapest upgrade among his skills; he holds the Arena defense front, Barricade 2 and the Be march.
evidence: hero.md: Gordon 25/50 manuals on his BBQ Feast screen (22 Oct); Emergency Snack Lv 2, 30 to Lv 3
recommendations.note: The Emergency Snack cost (30) is from the 21 Oct reading; check it on his skill screen.
